trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the second gold. Reach 100% completion: the checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but work you do earlier already counts. The thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts the checklist at roughly 60% of everything in the game — for example 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 15 of 18 meditations and 100 optional missions. Nothing on the checklist is missable: everything can still be done in free roam after the credits. Most of it fills in while you earn the other trophies, so leave this for last and mop up whatever the checklist still shows.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY THAT MAY BE MISSABLE. Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots in total, across 10 locations. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, so always bring your partner (the last spot needs both characters, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Track the count under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE MISSABLE PART: in Chapter 1, the morning after the main mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house and walks out to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. That session is gone once Chapter 1 ends. It is not yet confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. The 100% checklist needs only 15 of the 18 spots, but this trophy needs them all.

Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them on to your contacts to clean them, and the $250,000 total is cumulative — it does not need to be one job. Bank vault robberies (Maximum Withdrawal) are the richest source, so this trophy grows alongside them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything you buy counts. It fills up on its own over a full playthrough; if you are close at the end, buy an expensive weapon or a round of car upgrades to finish it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count — only the eight you buy. Buy them as soon as you can afford them, because garage space is also what On the Spot needs to register vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens with the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) and register cheap, common cars — ten registrations is all it takes.
